This work product provides information to monitor progress of test execution and allows for a formalized reporting on the status of the test effort. This information includes what tests have been performed and the status of those tests. Additionally, this work product identifies key areas of importance that help stakeholders in determining the state of the test effort.

To communicate testing activities and testing progress to stakeholders who use this information to address risks and issues which may inform decisions that impact timely and successful completion of the test effort.

Topics covered in this artifact include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Reporting period
  • Overall testing status (e.g., green, amber or red)
  • Key messages and major accomplishments
  • Summarized test results and key metrics including:
    • Productivity
    • Total number of test scripts
    • Number of executed test scripts
    • Number of passed test scripts
    • Test pass rate
    • Target percentage Executed
    • Percentage passed vs planned
    • percentage failed vs Planned
    • Number of failed test scripts
    • Test scripting effective rate
    • Number of blocked test scripts
    • Number of defects logged
    • Number of active defects
    • Net active severity 1 and 2 defects
    • Number of resolved defects
    • Defect retest turnaround effectiveness
    • Open vs closed defect trend
    • Defect turnaround rate
    • Defect rejection ratio
    • capacity utilization
  • Risks and issues
  • Risk mitigation strategies
  • Testing milestones
